children: TRELLEBORG: TRELLEBORG STRENGTHENS ITS POSITION IN THE AEROSPACE INDUSTRY THROUGH THE ACQUISITION OF TRI-MACK
THROUGH ITS BUSINESS AREA TRELLEBORG SEALING SOLUTIONS, HAS SIGNED AN AGREEMENT TO ACQUIRE US-BASED TRI-MACK PLASTICS MANUFACTURING CORP.
TRANSACTION IS EXPECTED TO BE COMPLETED DURING Q1 OF 2027.
TRI-MACK  SALES AMOUNTED TO APPROXIMATELY SEK 300 MILLION IN 2025.
